display_name: Phase1 源训练样本的基座语义稳定性诊断
description: 只使用 Phase1 L_s/U_s 配对 clean 与模拟接收 IQ，分四档检查冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 的分类一致率、特征余弦和 KL；不读真实标签或测试数据。
authorization: 用户要求研发更强星地恢复网络并严格限定 Phase1 地面训练、测试与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 基座。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch CPU only, original Phase1 frozen Tri-SIG-TIME release

data.representation: Source R07 view01 paired clean/received IQ and simulator noise variance; four variance quantile strata
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.actual_training_labels: No updates, no TX labels, no target or test IQ

permissions.regime: Source L_s/U_s only; immutable original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
permissions.claim_scope: 512 source records, label-free consistency diagnostic only

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50/11100 only
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Full original Tri-SIG-TIME source checkpoint ancestry and exact L_s/U_s physical ID sets
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Phase1 source-only model and source cache; fixed final E50 reader
checkpoint.selection_rule: One exact registered seed and source view; no candidate selection

execution.stop_rule: Input contract mismatch, nonfinite output, insufficient stratum or output collision: preserve evidence, no automatic retry

metric_names: clean vs received teacher top1 agreement
dimensions: 4 fixed source variance quartiles x 128 L_s/U_s samples
metrics_plan.targets_ref: diagnostic, not accuracy or a performance goal

notes: 诊断只计算 source clean 与 source received 两次冻结推断的一致性，不训练模型、不访问任何真实 TX 标签。
四个 source variance 分位区间各固定随机抽取 128 条，抽样 seed 2026110111；不以模型输出选择记录。
一致率不是准确率，不作星地测试性能推断；诊断结果只用于构思未来源训练目标，不改变已运行的 E30 训练。

rows.method: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL paired source predictions
rows.purpose: Diagnose source semantic distortion without TX labels
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source sample selection seed; no model training or test sampling
rows.scenario: Four R07 view01 source variance strata
rows.budget_ref: 512 source records, two frozen CPU forward passes each
